item.title: 【HD Live Performances】WEB-RiP - St. Vincent - Arte Concert Festival, La Gaite Lyrique, Paris, France, 25-10-2024 [best version]
item.description:
I captured this video from arte.tv. There are 2 versions made by arte.tv:
- the first version was AVC at 4GB and it looked pretty bad (lots of blocking artifacts) + good audio;
- the second version is HEVC at about 1.2GB, it's shorter (they cut some of Annie's banter) and it looks much better despite the lower size + terrible audio (a lot of clipping).

This is the third version: I took the good video from v2 and paired with the good audio from v1 (trimmed to fit v2 + normalized to be as loud a possible without clipping). It's safe to say this is the best version so far. Anyway, this a great & intense show, worth watching.
